data.body:
Operator decision (2026-08-19): APPROVED on both sub-questions.

(1) build_backend symmetry — YES, _build_datacenter SHOULD assert non-secret scope readiness (url/project) at build, while keeping PAT and network validation lazy in _LazyDataCenterClient. Asserting only the non-secret half preserves the property that composing a DC backend needs neither the [agents] extra nor a JIRA_PAT, so the design intent behind the lazy client is not lost while the asymmetry with _build_cloud is removed.

(2) assert_cloud_scope_ready strictness — KEEP STRICTER, and document it as an intended tightening rather than relaxing to match the legacy ambient assert_env_ready. These checks catch real misconfigurations: an email is genuinely required for Cloud Basic auth, and an empty query_project would query every project on the instance. Real Cloud deployments already satisfy both. Relaxing to match legacy would trade a working guard for consistency with the weaker of the two paths — the wrong direction. The path-dependent difference should be closed by documenting the stricter behavior as canonical, not by weakening it.
